notes:
• "New project…" next to "Open project…" and "Clone from GitHub…" (Mac, iPhone, iPad, Android): a name and a parent folder on the Mac (default ~/stellwerk/repos), and Stellwerk makes the folder with git and a first commit, optionally a private GitHub repository with gh, and adds it as a project.
• Several run scripts per repository (`[scripts.run.<name>]` with `command`, a lucide `icon` and `default`, as Conductor has them): the Mac's Run tab lists them, each with Run, Stop once it has been up a second, and Open once it printed a local address, plus its own terminal; each runs on its own port. Settings → project → Run scripts edits them with an icon picker. iPhone, iPad and Android show the running and failed ones over the chat and all of them under "…" → Run scripts. While a run script runs, the workspace's time in the workspace lists is in Conductor's activity blue, on every app, and the Mac's Run tab has a blue dot. `run_mode` is gone: run scripts always run side by side.
• Team host: one Mac shared by a small team. Choose "Team host" in the setup or Settings → Devices; each person pairs and signs in with GitHub (and Claude) on their phone or Mac. Messages show who wrote them, chats and workspaces who takes part, the message box who is typing. A turn runs on the Claude login, git author, GitHub token and gcloud config of the person who wrote it, with the chat's other people as co-authors; new branches carry their prefix, notifications go only to people in the chat. The Tailscale Serve port is a setting, so several macOS users can each run a host on one Mac. iOS, Android and the Mac window alike. A signed-in Mac pairs further phones as the same person (Settings → Account → Pair a phone), and the host reads GitHub with its people's sign-ins, so a bot account is optional.
• A workspace's setup script runs before its agent starts: the first prompt (and anything sent meanwhile, also after unarchiving) waits in the chat's queue until setup is done, failed or stopped, so the agent no longer runs setup steps of its own alongside it.
• Mac dashboards: back at the top of the sidebar under Search, with the page's favicon (the picked icon when it has none) and their ⌘⌥ shortcut at the row's end.
• Diffs: a long line scrolls sideways instead of being cut off on the Mac or wrapped on iPhone and iPad, as on Android.
• Fable 5.2 in the model picker, right after Opus 5.5; Fable 5.1 stays further down for chats that use it.
• The Mac host closes each git call's pipes as soon as git is done instead of a minute or two later: with many workspaces and terminals it held thousands of files open and ran into "Too many open files", and phones and the window couldn't reach it.
• Mac: a `stellwerk://` link, from a dashboard or elsewhere, no longer sends Stellwerk to the background while the window is open.
• Mac: the sidebar, the right panel and the Setup / Run logs have no fixed maximum anymore; they grow as far as the chat keeps its minimum width (and the panel's top its minimum height), as in Conductor.
• When Claude only wakes up for a line from a Monitor, its end no longer sends a "finished" notification for every line.
• iPhone notifications: "Only for messages from the phone" works again. Messages typed in a Mac's Stellwerk window no longer count as the phone's, and the Operator's work counts only when the phone asked for it.
• The Mac host raises its open-file limit at launch, so big projects no longer fail with "Too many open files".
• The host log names its open files and the limit at start, and notes when they pass half or most of the limit (and when they're back down), so a leak shows before "Too many open files".
• PR badge shows the pull request of the branch checked out now: when an agent switches to a new branch, the workspace follows it instead of keeping its first branch's PR.
• Mac: pressing the PR button (Create PR, Merge, …) shows a spinner in the icon's color and size in its place; the icon no longer just vanishes for a moment on the light Create PR button.
• Mac: the default color theme is called Stellwerk instead of Conductor, and the Run tab, run script settings and "Ask agent" prompts name `$STELLWERK_PORT` / `$STELLWERK_ROOT_PATH` instead of the `CONDUCTOR_*` ones (both are still set). Stellwerk's own types drop the old name (`StellwerkDB`, `StellwerkColor`, `Host/Store`).
• iPhone and Android: the setup script's row over the chat shows only while the script runs or after it failed, no longer "Completed setup script" for good. On iPhone the row now has a background, so the chat no longer shows through it. The setup log stays in the "…" menu.
• Mac: text pasted after an attachment in the message box (⌘V, or dictated with apps like Wispr Flow that paste) is sent again. Only the attachment reached the agent.
